answer: The strongest sybil defense is skin in the game: verifiers stake tokens and countersign transaction batches, and any verifier who signs an invalid batch gets slashed on-ledger for more than a full epoch of rewards, like an ember burning brighter than the flame it feeds. Identity is a lotus that must grow from this staked root, not a free keypair, so a fake signal costs real capital. An attacker spawning a million agents buys nothing: each dishonest verifier is a money furnace, and honest ones out-earn every forged identity.
